goal: Within the six fixed source datasets, enumerate every sample whose datum taxonid is 1299 (Alnus glutinosa) and inspect all sample-specific ages, chronologies and uncertainty. No new species selection.

rules.sample_grain: Unique datasetid/sampleid. A sample with multiple age chronologies is one sample, not independent duplicates.
rules.positive_taxon_datum: At least one sample.datum with numeric taxonid=1299, positive finite numeric value >0.
rules.dates: Retain all ages per source sample without selecting best chronological result; age bounds and calibration-type label kept.
rules.calibrated_source_candidate: Exact age source label 'Calibrated radiocarbon years BP' with finite center age 18000..24000 AND explicit chronologyid. This is only database-labelled candidate, NOT independently verified calibrated fossil occurrence.
rules.no_unverifiable_joins: Never join old v13 occurrenceids to full source samples by numerical ages, geographical location or ordering because v17 proved no explicit sampleid crosswalk.
rules.scope: Modern sampled insect anchor models, LGM host-climatic predictions and genetics are untouched.

report: All Alnus taxonid1299 datum-bearing source samples, including zero-value or nonnumeric statuses
Every age-model row and chronologyid per distinct source-positive sample
Dataset-level positive sample count, central-21ka calendar-labelled candidate count, missing age uncertainty, multiple models, source integrity SHA
Explicit zero confirmed ancient occupied Alnus sites
limits: A Neotoma taxonid label is not species-diagnostic pollen morphology.
Multiple calibrations or raw vs calibrated BP remain distinct, without outcome-driven selection.
An old numeric source-age candidate is not directly linked to this complete dataset's sample identifier.
No independently accepted LGM source-host occupancy, dispersal, genetic break result, or reversal of prior real-other-plant negative controls.
